title: Ship bee-teach as a bee skill
action: Create one NEW bee skill from the verified local port .claude/skills/teach/SKILL.md (per D1). Do NOT run bee dev regen (regen_obligation_ack wave-barrier; psh-4 runs the one regen). FRONTMATTER as in the bee-writing-skills checklist and the shape of skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md: name bee-teach, a folded description, metadata version '0.1', ecosystem bee, and dependencies copied from the bee-cli mapping in skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md. No disable-model-invocation key. Description, exactly: Explain a body of work plainly so a person understands it. Use when the user asks to understand rather than change something — 'teach me', 'explain this', 'why did you build it this way', 'I don't get X'. Not for status reports, gate questions the user has not asked to understand, or changing code. BODY: keep all five steps and the writing rules, with these changes (per D4). (1) Replace every use of the how and why skills with bee's procedures: a how-does-this-run question uses the `Trace` procedure and a why-is-this-so question uses the `Provenance sweep` procedure, both in `skills/bee-researching/references/trace-and-provenance.md` (backticked path, quoted headings "Trace" and "Provenance sweep"). Step 2's narrowing advice becomes: keep the Provenance sweep narrow by default, and name every category you did not sweep as UNSWEPT, per that procedure. (2) Add one rule near the top: at a gate, the Gate Presentation Contract and the one-next-action rule in `skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md` ("Communication contract") win over this skill's shape; teach explains only what the user asked to understand, then returns to the gate question. (3) Step 4's 'Offer to go deeper or move on' and the Reply line's 'the threads worth chasing' become: close on exactly one next action, never a menu. (4) 'in plain spoken English' becomes 'in plain spoken language, in the user's language'. (5) Every mention of the unslop skill becomes `bee-unslop`. Provenance line: Ported from pstack (cursor/plugins, pstack/skills/teach), adapted for bee. Add a short `## Headless` section: deliver the explanation in one pass, with the one next action at the end. End with: Explanation delivered. Invoke bee-hive skill. CREATION-LOG.md from the template: source material; extraction decisions, including why the gate trigger was removed (the hat-user-impact seat found it would turn every gate into a menu) and why the close became one next action; the named deviation as in psh-1; RED S4 (pressures Time + Exhaustion + Social) recorded verbatim as FAILED on the teaching rules — a preview line 'Plan is at its gate. Here is why it is three cells and not one.', a metaphor 'Think of it as one Lego brick: you press it down, you check it holds, then you add the next brick.', a long list-heavy wall instead of the smallest complete answer first, and a closing two-option menu; GREEN and Final Outcome left as 'pending, recorded by cell psh-4'.
